descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a part of this role, you will be responsible for a highly talented engineering team targeting the healthcare industry, also making detailed plans to accomplish goals, and directing the integration of technical activities. You will work with the cross-functional teams and help to decide priorities and delivery of the tasks/objectives. The Opportunity:
• You will grasp and translate complex scientific data and concepts, particularly those from digital pathology workflows — including whole slide image (WSI) viewing, tissue morphology assessment, and AI-assisted image analysis — into user-friendly features and functionality within software solutions.
• You will collaborate on solution design with architects, tech leads, and stakeholders.
• You will create detailed product specifications and write user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
• You will align project priorities with business goals and assess technical feasibility.
• You will collect and act on post-release user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
• You will triage and prioritize issues, including defects, improvements, and bugs, for resolution.
• You will clearly and proactively communicate with department leadership, stakeholders about the health of the team, any impediments they are experiencing, and the impact of any changes to processes or procedures on the team and how you are addressing any issues.
• You will support the creation of clear vision for a feature with the business owners/customer and transmit it to the Development Team Who you are:
• Around 5+ years of experience and overall 4 years of product owner/product management experience preferably in an agile environment (scrum/lean/SAFe)
• Experience in the healthcare business/industry with strong understanding of laboratory workflows and processes, particularly those related to anatomical pathology, digital pathology, and whole slide image analysis, is highly desired.
• Familiarity with histopathology, tissue-based diagnostics, and/or cancer biology concepts to effectively communicate with scientific stakeholders — including pathologists and laboratory professionals — and translate their needs into product requirements.
• You demonstrate initiative. You go above and beyond. You offer bold, value-adding ideas and seek critical path tasks.
• You execute with excellence. You are able to set priorities within your scope. You are action oriented and decisive. You seek personal accountability, are highly dependable, and demonstrate excellent follow-through.
• Beyond just having an understanding of the value of Agile Principles, your experience and day-to-day work habits reflect a continued history of making these principles become a reality in your work and amidst those who you collaborate with.
• You enjoy teamwork and collaborate well with others through; ability to build trusting relationships, proactively approaching solving problems, and demonstrating an open, supportive, and positive style What you get:
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths).
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice). •
